'''Valoria''' is one of the source-listed continents of the Avant world.

The current source dump provides Valoria as a continent name through the extracted [[List of Continents]], but no dedicated Valoria geography page has been found in this checkout. This draft therefore exists only as a bridge so the continent list remains complete.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not use Valoria to make state-placement, border, ocean, or historical claims until a map pass or stronger source material identifies its location and political geography.
